description: This file defines the WatchMessagingService class responsible for managing communication between an iOS app and an Apple Watch using WatchConnectivity. It includes error handling, session management, message sending, and receiving functionality, as well as status monitoring.

classes.name: WatchMessagingService
classes.description: A service class for managing WatchConnectivity sessions, sending notifications, and handling quick reply events between iOS and Apple Watch.

methods.name: isSupportedOnDevice
methods.description: Checks if the current device supports WatchConnectivity.

methods.name: currentStatusSnapshot
methods.description: Provides a snapshot status of the watch session capabilities.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current watch session status.

methods.name: setReplyHandler
methods.description: Sets a callback handler for quick reply events from the watch.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a notification to the watch with specified parameters.

methods.name: ensureActivated
methods.description: Ensures that the WCSession is activated, awaiting activation if necessary.
